name: IconCutCards
description: An invented AI delivery platform on a dark ground, built from cards cut by their own icons
intent: Forty-two keyframes, which is the most animation of any page here, held together by one idea: the icon is cut out of the card rather than placed on it, so the stack reads as one printed object when it moves.

source.title: Icon-Cut Card Stack Page
source.author: Ray Velez
source.changed: New brand, copy and figures, and a retuned palette
